Globle Game - Guess the Country

globle.org
https://globle.org
Globle is a game inspired by Wordle and it will test your knowledge of geography. Can you guess the mystery country? using the fewest number of guesses.
AI Overview
Globle is a daily geography guessing game where you try to find a hidden "Mystery Country" on an interactive 3D globe. 
Globle
 +2
How to Play
Make a guess: Type the name of any country to start. 
Read the color clues: Each guessed country lights up on the globe with a temperature color:
Blue / Colder colors: Far away (more than 5,000 km).
Yellow / Orange: Getting closer (between 250 km and 5,000 km).
Burning Red / Hot colors: Very close to the target (within 250 km). 
Globle
 +1
Check the distance and arrow: Every guess shows the exact kilometer distance and a compass direction pointing toward the target country. 
Google Play
 +1
Unlimited guesses: Keep guessing until you locate the right country. A new mystery country appears every single day. 
Globle
 +2
Where to Play
Play directly in your web browser at the official Globle Game or Globle Org.
Access additional game modes and practice options through Globle+ Partner or mobile apps on Google Play. 
If you'd like, let me know:
Are you stuck on today's mystery country?
Do you want to try out Globle: Capitals or Practice Mode?
I can help give you a hint or explain how the distance rules work!
